competitors.title: AgentLedger — Monitor & Control Your AI Agents
key_points: SDK-based observability platform tracking real-world agent actions (not just LLM calls)
Live SSE streaming of every action with sub-second latency
Policy engine with pre-built templates: conservative, cost-conscious, compliance
Human-in-the-loop approvals via dashboard, Slack, Discord, or PagerDuty
Advanced analytics with multi-day trend analysis and cost forecasting via linear regression
Trace replay and debugging with action-by-action visual timeline
Python & TypeScript SDKs, CLI, plus 8 integrations (LangChain, OpenAI, MCP, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK)

competitors.title: AgentLedger — Know what your agents cost (Open-Source Reverse Proxy)
key_points: Open-source reverse proxy (Apache 2.0) between AI agents and LLM providers
Zero code changes — set one env var (OPENAI_BASE_URL) and done
15 LLM providers supported: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Cohere, xAI, Perplexity, Together AI, Fireworks AI, OpenRouter, Cerebras, SambaNova
83+ models with up-to-date built-in pricing
<10ms proxy overhead with zero dependencies
Real-time cost tracking with per-request metering and per-token counting
Budget enforcement with daily/monthly limits, soft warnings, and hard blocks
Pre-flight estimation — calculates worst-case cost before forwarding to API
Agent session tracking — groups multi-call runs into sessions
Loop detection — automatically detects and stops runaway agents in infinite loops
Ghost agent detection — finds agents still running but idle, preventing silent cost bleed
Embedded web dashboard with real-time cost visibility (no Grafana/Datadog needed)
Prometheus + OpenTelemetry metrics with pre-built Grafana dashboard template
Multi-tenancy with tenant-scoped budgets and dashboard filtering
MCP tool metering alongside LLM usage
Circuit breaker for automatic upstream failure protection
Install via Homebrew, binary download, Docker, or Helm (Kubernetes)

competitors.title: AgentLedger: The Ledger for AI Agents (Financial Control Layer)
key_points: Financial control layer between AI agents and payment methods (credit cards)
AES-256-GCM encrypted credential vault — card details decrypted only at moment of release
Per-agent budget limits — cumulative or monthly, enforced atomically
Full audit trail with every transaction logged (amount, merchant, purpose, agent, timestamp)
Two MCP servers: one for spending agent, one for supervisor agent
Three delegation tiers: Manual (human approves), Supervised (AI overseer), Autonomous (fully delegated)
Framework-agnostic — works with OpenClaw, Paperclip, CrewAI, LangChain, or raw HTTP
~11 MB on disk, <50ms cold start, <1ms per request, ~10 MB RAM, zero runtime deps
Single static Go binary — no Python, no Node, no Docker required
Free and open source (AGPL-3.0) for self-hosted Local edition
Hosted editions coming soon with Telegram approvals, multi-card support, team access
